description: Run a backtest of the 'SampleMACrossover' strategy on MSFT (Daily data) for the full year of 2024 (Jan 1, 2024 - Dec 31, 2024). Once the backtest is complete, navigate to the 'Executions' tab in the Strategy Analyzer results to view the individual trades. Finally, export the execution list to a CSV file named 'msft_executions.csv' in the 'My Documents' folder (C:\Users\Docker\Documents).
